## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you'd like to see.

## Problem / Motivation

Describe the problem this feature would solve, or the motivation behind the request.
Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Include any relevant details about how it should work.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered and why they may or may not work.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, links to related issues, or examples that might help explain the feature request.

## Would you be willing to implement this feature?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to submit a PR for this feature
- [ ] I can help with testing
- [ ] No, I'm just suggesting
